summary: 3M Company filed an 8-K reporting its subsidiary, Fire Safety Platform Holdco, Inc., entered into a credit agreement for a $1.43 billion term loan facility and a $200 million revolving credit facility. The proceeds will finance the acquisition of Madison Safety Flow Holdings LLC from Madison Industries. The facilities mature 364 days after closing, extendable by up to 12 months. 3M guarantees the borrower's liabilities. Terms of the acquisition itself (price, premium, etc.) are not disclosed. The filing establishes the debt financing for a pending acquisition. Watch for further details on the target and regulatory clearance.
